name: m2b
description: Your second brain for Claude Code, one store across all your projects and machines: capture notes, search them, see your tasks, get a small curated distillate in every session, see in a band above the prompt what waits for your answer, and keep or drop what curation proposes in the m2b pane. One add-on, off until set up: a worklog of your agent sessions in herdr.
